migration_flags.description: mrp.routing standalone model is absent in v19. No class declaring _name='mrp.routing' exists anywhere in addons/mrp/. The shared routing concept (one routing reused by many BOMs) has been eliminated.
migration_flags.pointer: addons/mrp/models/ — grep returned no results for class MrpRouting or _name = 'mrp.routing'

migration_flags.description: Fields routing_id on mrp.bom and mrp.production are absent in v19. grep on both model files returns no results.
migration_flags.pointer: mrp_bom.py — no routing_id; mrp_production.py — no routing_id

migration_flags.description: mrp.routing.workcenter now has bom_id as a required Many2one with ondelete='cascade' directly to mrp.bom. The model retains its technical name but is no longer a child of mrp.routing.

No simple capacity = Float field exists on mrp.workcenter. Replaced by capacity_ids = One2many to mrp.workcenter.capacity which supports per-product, per-UOM capacity with per-product setup/cleanup overrides.
tag_ids = Many2many('mrp.workcenter.tag') added to mrp.workcenter. The tag model is defined in the same file with a unique name constraint and a random color index.

Work order scheduling creates resource.calendar.leaves records with time_type='other' on the work center calendar. date_start and date_finished on mrp.workorder are computed from leave_id.date_from/date_to.

key_findings.routing_architecture: mrp.routing model removed; mrp.routing.workcenter now has required bom_id with cascade; operations are direct children of mrp.bom via operation_ids One2many
key_findings.capacity_model: Per-product capacity via mrp.workcenter.capacity; _get_capacity() resolves priority: exact product+uom > no-product+unit > no-product+product-uom > default
key_findings.oee_formula: oee = productive_time * 100.0 / (productive_time + blocked_time); based on last-month closed productivity logs
key_findings.workcenter_load: Sum of duration_expected (minutes) for workorders in states blocked/ready/progress
key_findings.workorder_state_machine: 5 states: blocked/ready/progress/done/cancel; blocked<->ready driven by qty_ready>0; leave_id creates calendar slot on workcenter
key_findings.workorder_creation: _compute_workorder_ids on mrp.production explodes BOM then iterates bom.operation_ids; each operation creates one workorder with state=ready
key_findings.tag_ids: New many-to-many tag field on mrp.workcenter; tag model with name unique constraint and color index 1-11
